situational_context: Running comeback C4 block (#21-40) significantly under-executed: W33-W35 had 5 skipped runs, distances consistently below targets. Extended deload triggered by persistent autonomic suppression — HRV weekly avg dropped from 36 (BALANCED) to 30 (LOW) over 3 weeks since mid-August, paired with RHR drift from 49→53 bpm and body battery depression (avg ~38 vs ~45 in July). Run #29 (Aug 22, 7.04 km, suffer 51) exceeded C4 HR caps and was never properly recovered from. Chronic load declined 26% (24.7→18.2) since Aug 14. ACWR recovered from 0.59 to 0.82 — just above the 0.8 floor but only because chronic base dropped. Training status shifted from 'Detraining' to 'Maintaining' with ebike commutes providing baseline load. Now on congés Sep 1-11 (Léonie daycare adaptation) — no 'sur site' constraints, flexible schedule for gentle re-entry. The 12 km Beaumonts objective (block W36) is deferred; focus this week is rebuilding consistent run volume from the 3.5 km deload baseline. VO2max running dipped slightly to 42.5 (from 42.9). Vitamin D retest still overdue (no labs since Dec 2025). No nutrition logging for 2+ weeks.

recommendations.text: Vitamin D retest is now 2+ months overdue (last panel Dec 2025, 27 ng/mL insufficient). Congés this week provides a window to schedule a blood draw. Insufficient Vitamin D at this body weight roughly doubles stress-fracture risk during the running comeback (Burgi 2011).
recommendations.measurable: Lab order placed this week; result logged within 10 days

recommendations.text: HRV weekly avg has been persistently LOW (30 ms) for 2+ weeks, down 17% from the early-August BALANCED baseline of 36. Paired with RHR elevation (+3-4 bpm) and depressed body battery. Accept HRV 28-30 as the current operating baseline rather than waiting for full recovery to 36 — use training readiness (≥60) + RHR (≤54) as the run/no-run gate. Prioritize sleep consistency (the Aug 27 night at 4.95h was a setback) and stress management during congés.
recommendations.measurable: HRV weekly avg stabilises at ≥30 (no further decline); RHR 7d avg ≤53 sustained for 5+ days

recommendations.text: Resume nutrition logging — no meals have been logged for 2+ weeks. At ~101 kg during a running comeback, protein intake (target ≥150g/day) and hydration are critical for tissue adaptation and recovery. The gap makes it impossible to assess nutritional contributions to the autonomic suppression.
